class.name: TTSPersonaSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the player's text-to-speech personas and the player's default persona.

method.name: add_persona
method.description: Stores a copy of [param persona] as the player's persona under its [member TTSPersona.persona_name]. An entry with the same name is replaced (its position and its [member TTSPersonaSettings.default] flag stay). If the game has a persona with this name, the player's version replaces it in [TTSServer]. Reports an error if [param persona] is [code]null[/code] or has no name. Changing [param persona] later does not change the stored entry; call [method add_persona] again or use [method set_persona_value].

method.name: get_default_persona
method.description: Returns the name of the player's default persona, or an empty [StringName] if the player has not chosen one (then the default persona of the game is used, see [method TTSServer.set_default_persona]).

method.name: get_missing_voice_personas
method.description: Returns the names of the stored personas whose [member TTSPersonaSettings.voice] is set but does not exist on the current device (by voice ID or voice name). [TTSServer] uses another voice for them (see [method TTSServer.resolve_voice_id]). Returns an empty array while the device reports no voices at all: text to speech is not available, or on the Web the voice list is still loading.

method.name: get_persona
method.description: Returns a new [TTSPersona] with the stored values of the player's persona called [param name] (pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]), or [code]null[/code] if the player has no such persona. Changing the returned persona does not change the settings.

method.name: get_persona_names
method.description: Returns the names of the player's personas, in the order of the list. The personas of the game that the player has not changed are not included; see [method TTSServer.get_persona_names] for all personas.

method.name: get_persona_value
method.description: Returns the value [param property] of the persona called [param name] (a property of [TTSPersonaSettings], for example [code]"rate"[/code]): the player's value if the player has this persona, otherwise the value of the game's persona in [TTSServer]. Reports an error and returns [code]null[/code] if there is no such persona.

method.name: has_persona
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the player has a stored persona called [param name] (created or changed by the player).

method.name: remove_persona
method.description: Removes the player's persona called [param name]. If the game has a persona with this name, it is used again. If it was the player's default persona, the default persona of the game is used again. Does nothing if the player has no such persona.

method.name: set_default_persona
method.description: Makes the persona called [param name] the player's default persona: [method TTSServer.speak] without a persona uses it. If the player has no persona with this name yet, the entry is created from the game's persona in [TTSServer] (a copy of its current values). Reports an error if there is no such persona. An empty [param name] removes the player's choice, so the default persona of the game is used again.

method.name: set_persona_value
method.description: Sets the value [param property] of the player's persona called [param name] (a property of [TTSPersonaSettings], for example [code]"voice"[/code], [code]"volume"[/code] or [code]"rate"[/code]). The value is clamped to the range of the property. If the player has no persona with this name yet but the game has one, the player's entry is created from the values of the game first. Setting [code]"default"[/code] calls [method set_default_persona]. The name itself can't be changed. Reports an error if there is no such persona or property.
